audience: fundraising and membership staff at nonprofits who manage donors, members and events in Neon CRM

useCases.title: Look up a supporter's donations and memberships
useCases.text: The AI finds an account by name or email and lists its donations (amount, date, fund, campaign, status) and its membership history. You see what one supporter has given.

useCases.title: Find upcoming events and who registered
useCases.text: The AI lists events by name, category or date window and reads one event with its registrations, tickets and attendees.

useCases.title: Check membership levels and renewal status
useCases.text: The AI lists the membership levels with their status and reads memberships with term, dates, fee, status and auto-renewal. You see which memberships are active or have failed.

useCases.title: Check how a fundraising campaign is doing
useCases.text: The AI lists campaigns and reads one with its dates, goal, fund and fundraising statistics. You can compare progress against the goal.

useCases.title: Add a new account for a person or company
useCases.text: The AI first checks for an account with the same email, then creates an individual or company account. Neon may merge it into a matching account.

useCases.title: Log or update an activity with a supporter
useCases.text: The AI creates an activity with a subject, start date, status and priority, or changes an existing one, for example to mark it completed.
